dc_eval_cbrn.quote: Altogether, we believe that Claude 3.7 Sonnet continues to be sufficiently far away from the ASL-3 capability thresholds
dc_eval_cbrn.note: Uplift trial scores, VCT, LabBench, long-form virology 69.7%.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: The model succeeded in 13/23 (56%) easy tasks and in 4/13 (30%) medium difficulty evaluations

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: Results: The production model achieved a 23% success rate on the hard subset of SWE-bench Verified, falling short of our 50% threshold for 2-8 hour software engineering tasks.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: AI R&D automation threat model; RE-Bench, internal AI research suite.

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: Our Safeguards team's model evaluations included single-turn and multi-turn tests covering our high harm usage policies related to Child Safety, Cyber Attacks, Dangerous Weapons and Technology, Hate & Discrimination, Influence Operations
dc_eval_persuasion.locator: 3 Evaluations and Safeguards for Child Safety and Bias
dc_eval_persuasion.note: Influence Operations tested as a policy area; no specific result. Manipulation monitored in thinking (5.2) with rate for 'deceiving or manipulating the user'.

dc_eval_scheming.quote: Claude 3.7 Sonnet showed marked improvement, with alignment faking dropping to <1% of instances and a reduced compliance gap of only 5%.
dc_eval_scheming.note: Also deceptive reasoning 0.37% and CoT faithfulness scores.

framework_threshold.quote: Based on our assessments, we've concluded that Claude 3.7 Sonnet is released under the ASL-2 standard.

ext_test_any.quote: uplift trials with both internal and external testers, third-party expert red teaming and assessments

ext_test_named_org.quote: Domain experts from Deloitte engaged in extended conversations with Claude, assessing its ability to assist users with complex domain-specific challenges in weapons development.
ext_test_named_org.note: Also Sepal.ai, SecureBio, Pattern Labs, METR.

ext_test_government.quote: the U.S. AI Safety Institute (U.S. AISI) and U.K. AI Security Institute (U.K. AISI) conducted pre-deployment testing of Claude 3.7 Sonnet

safeguards_training.note: Also harmlessness training and preference-model training in section 2.

safeguards_runtime.quote: Our Safeguards team also runs continuous classifiers to monitor prompts and outputs for harmful use cases that violate our AUP.
